result:
Wrote `index.md` to the parent dir. Cover SVG drafted by scout-illustrator.

Synthesis highlights the load-bearing finding (MLS has no walkable hotels — only Airbnbs in Moutfort/Oetrange), shows how accepting a taxi turns the lodging and day-trip reports into three coherent archetypes (city base, spa spine, Moselle tour), notes Voxxed Days as the cleanest tech-pairing, and flags the one gap — children verified opening days, parking, taxi callback, and no on-site rooms, but never pinned down tasting-menu price, pairing cost, or lead time — pointing to the MLS phone number as the next step.
